Tent on the slope of Duolba Sároaivi in the north part of Muotkatunturit Wilderness Area. In the background the lake Gáregasgeažejávri and mountains in Paistunturit Wilderness Area (or in Kevo Strict Nature Reserve) on the other side of the road from Kaamanen to Karigasniemi. The ground is a little stony, but here there are less mosquitoes than by the lake – and a nice view.
